subtopic: Lock-Free Data Structures and Atomic Primitives
question_text: What hardware CPU instruction forms the foundation of optimistic lock-free synchronization primitives?
answer_explanation: Atomic CAS reads a memory location, compares its value to an expected value, and if identical, writes the new value atomically in hardware, returning whether the swap succeeded.
reference_solution: Correct Choice: A. Rationale: Atomic CAS reads a memory location, compares its value to an expected value, and if identical, writes the new value atomically in hardware, returning whether the swap succeeded.
